title: Two Little Girls Holding Birthday Cakes in Garden, 1930s Snapshot Photo
description: Two young girls pose outdoors in a sunny, rock-lined backyard garden, each proudly holding up a frosted birthday cake on a platter. They are dressed in typical late 1930s style collared dresses with puffed short sleeves, bobbed haircuts, and bangs. The scene captures an intimate childhood celebration during the pre-WWII era, enhanced by a camera light flare across the upper left. The reverse side bears four vintage album mounting remnants with black paper fibers and a faint stamped number.
